answer_1.quote: Conversational recommender systems (CRSs) have become one of the trending research topics in recent years , utilizing the user's online feedback to conduct dynamic and explainable recommendations through interactive conversations with the user.
answer_1.outputs: The system generates conversational turns involving asking about user interests (aspects and attributes) and recommending items based on a hierarchical interest tree.

answer_2.quote: Following ; ; , we utilize the success rate at turn t (SR@t)  to measure the cumulative ratio of successful recommendation with the maximum turn T , and average turn (AT) to evaluate the average number of turns. Besides, we adopt hDCG@(T ,K)  to additionally evaluate the ranking performance of recommendations.
